subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw core own a default-off TUI-client completion notifier, and if so which modes should be supported for local and remote Gateway sessions?
rationale: The request adds new user-facing TUI behavior and config, and existing plugin/node notification surfaces only partially cover the use case because they do not guarantee local TUI-client alerts in Gateway-connected mode.

options.title: Approve a narrow TUI notifier
options.body: Add a default-off TUI-client alert surface with explicit mode semantics, safe platform handling, and focused TUI validation.

options.title: Route to plugin/node notifications
options.body: Keep core TUI unchanged and document plugin `agent_end` or node notification patterns for users who can tolerate host-side alerts rather than local TUI-client alerts.

options.title: Defer notification surface
options.body: Leave the issue open as an ergonomics idea until maintainers are ready to accept new TUI config and platform behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow TUI notifier
recommendation.body: Add a default-off TUI-client alert surface with explicit mode semantics, safe platform handling, and focused TUI validation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal around the TUI finalization/status path where this behavior would belong.
